name: Response instruction injection whose word separators are Hangul fillers
notes: U+3164 HANGUL FILLER renders as blank width and was on no list. It is folded to a SPACE (not stripped): NFKC maps it onto U+1160, which normalizeSegment turns into a space before the default-ignorable strip. A filler INSIDE a word (`ig<filler>nore`) splits the word and is not matched -- a documented, pinned gap; the metadata carriers still flag the filler itself. #114.
